items.textToSpeech: Based on data from the United States Department of Agriculture, the highest food source of peonidin by weight is raw blueberries, which contain as much as 60 milligrams of peonidin per 100 grams. Raw bilberry, raw rabbiteye blueberries, raw wild blueberries, and raw cranberries, all contain as much as 15 milligrams of peonidin or more per 100 grams. Is there anything else I can help you with?
